finding.title: Project deletion may lack object authorization
finding.explanation: The changed endpoint delegates deletion without visible ownership enforcement.
finding.fix: Authorize the current principal before deletion.
finding.test: Attempt cross-tenant deletion and assert denial.

evidence_question: Inspect remove_project and determine whether it enforces object ownership before deletion.
evidence_fact: remove_project loads and deletes the selected project without consulting a principal or ownership policy.

finding.title: Redirect target may accept an external URL
finding.explanation: The changed login path passes an untrusted target into a redirect helper.
finding.test: Reject absolute and scheme-relative redirect targets.

evidence_question: Inspect redirect_to and determine whether it constrains external redirect targets.
evidence_fact: redirect_to copies its target directly into the Location header without scheme or host validation.

finding.title: Delivery helper may retry forever
finding.explanation: The changed job path delegates retry policy to an opaque helper.
finding.fix: Bound attempts and preserve the caller deadline.
finding.test: Force persistent failure and assert terminal exhaustion.

evidence_question: Inspect deliver_with_retry and establish whether retry attempts are bounded.
evidence_fact: deliver_with_retry loops forever after TimeoutError and has no attempt or deadline check.

finding.title: Concurrent misses may stampede the origin
finding.explanation: The changed path relies on an opaque cache-fill helper.
finding.fix: Coalesce concurrent cache fills per key.
finding.test: Race callers on one cold key and assert one origin request.

evidence_question: Inspect fetch_cached and determine whether concurrent misses are coalesced.
evidence_fact: fetch_cached calls load_origin independently for every miss and has no lock or single-flight mechanism.

# PILOT_EVIDENCE:support-cache-stampede
def fetch_cached(key):
    value = cache.get(key)
    if value is None:
        value = load_origin(key)
        cache[key] = value
    return value

finding.title: Project deletion lacks ownership validation
finding.explanation: The changed endpoint appears to delete an attacker-selected project.

evidence_question: Inspect remove_owned_project and verify whether ownership is already enforced.
evidence_fact: remove_owned_project calls authorize_owner before the delete and raises when the principal is not the owner.

finding.title: Account lookup may interpolate attacker input

evidence_question: Inspect find_account and determine whether the email is bound as a query parameter.

finding.title: Remote profile fetch may have no deadline
finding.explanation: The changed request does not pass an explicit timeout.
finding.test: Stall the service and assert deadline cancellation.

evidence_question: Inspect service_client and establish whether fetch applies a bounded default timeout.
evidence_fact: service_client is constructed with a five-second default timeout that fetch applies to every request.

finding.title: Untrusted command runs through a shell

finding.fix: Pass a fixed executable and argument array without a shell.
finding.test: Treat shell metacharacters as literal arguments.

evidence_fact: The changed line itself is sufficient to accept the finding.
